column1: # What a Claude Code cloud session gets of the toolbox projects/felix/stack.tsv
# declares, and why. Read by .claude/cloud/provision; every plugin and skill row
# in stack.tsv needs a row here, and the gate's `cloud` check fails when one is
# missing, so a new stack row forces a decision about the cloud instead of
# silently not arriving there.
# Plugins never load in a cloud session, whether a user or a repository enables
# them (code.claude.com/docs/en/cloud-environments, "What carries over"). What
# does load is this repository's .claude/skills, .claude/agents and
# .claude/commands, so `fetch` rows are carried as those: provision downloads
# the plugin at the commit pinned here and copies its skills, agents and
# commands into the clone. The shas are the ones installed on the founder's
# machine on 2026-09-25 (~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json), so the cloud
# runs what a local session runs; move a pin when the local install moves.
# carry: fetch     downloaded at sha and copied into .claude/
#        builtin   Claude Code itself ships an equivalent under the same name
#        claude.ai arrives through the skills enabled on claude.ai
#        no        not carried; the note says why
